title: ieee1905: Add Available Spectrum Inquiry Request/Response TLVs
description:
Adding support for the "Available Spectrum Inquire Request and Response TLV"
+ the "Available Spectrum Inquiry Message"

Both are used for AFC (Automatic Frequency Coordination) in the 6G band

See Wi-Fi EasyMesh Specification Version 6.0 chapters 17.2.104 and 17.2.105
